withdrawalRevocationMechanism.procedure: Participant withdrawal of C1–C4 is designed in D16; authorization revocation requires a recorded revocation authority and register

inferenceGuard: The Master Prompt, a PR approval, a task assignment, a passing validator, a prepared template or an agent inference does not constitute outreach authorization; authorization must be a separate, dated, scoped record naming the authorizer and the authority basis.
fieldMapNote: Master Prompt field 5 ('authorizing person and authority basis') is compound and expands to authorizingPerson + authorityBasis; the 30 numbered fields therefore serialise as 31 flat keys, and currentAuthorizationStatus is a derived gate value repeated from authorizationStatus. This record mirrors AUTH-MC10-001-REV2-DRAFT (D13) section 7 field-for-field. D13 section 7.1 status values are mirrored as sibling keys documentStatus, authorizationStatus, fieldworkPermission and externalContactAllowed; they are deliberately not folded into currentAuthorizationStatus so that no consumer can read an ungranted record as permission. incentivePolicy and withdrawalRevocationMechanism are objects that carry proposal and accountability metadata; neither object confers approval or operability. No field carries an invented human, legal, controller, contact, signature, storage or interviewer value.
